newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,045 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,045 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 2,045 contracts compared with 1,670 overnight Thursday.

There were 292 wheat, 1,154 corn, 529 soybean, 27 soymeal, 18 soyoil, two oat, one rice, one wheat call, five corn calls, two corn puts, seven soybean calls, two soybean puts and five soymeal calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 cent higher to two cents lower, corn was steady to 1-1/4 cents lower and soybeans were five cents higher to two cents lower.
